depth_justification: Asks distinct, well-aimed app-specific questions that track MindBoost's disclosures (cognitive-overload safety for stroke/dementia, clinician difficulty-adjustment, Swiss/German data handling, motor-function adaptability, progress-data security, elderly UI accessibility) with no looping, but it never progresses past questions into analysis and the closing 'report' is a four-line gap list with no real risk reasoning.
actionability_justification: Entirely interrogative with no mitigations anywhere; the explicitly requested risk report is a bare list of undefined gaps with no severity grouping (despite the ask) and nothing a developer could implement.
salient_examples: What measures are in place to prevent cognitive overload ... during game-based exercises in MindBoost ...? [P7.D1]
What strategies ... ensure that clinicians can effectively monitor and adjust the difficulty ...? [P3.D2]
Risk Report: [P1.D4] - Adaptability to motor and physical ability not yet defined. ... Uncovered dimensions: [P1.D2], [P2.D1] ... (no severity grouping, no mitigations)
